Layer 4 · Money

What arrives offshore?

A dividend is taxed twice before it leaves: corporate income tax on the profit, then withholding tax on the distribution. Treaties reduce the second, not the first. Model both before you plan the cash flow.

Net received offshore —
  • Corporate income tax—
  • Statutory reserve—
  • Distributable profit—
  • Withholding tax—
  • VAT and surcharges—
  • Effective rate on profit—

What the model assumes

  • The profit is already realised and the accounts are audited
  • Withholding tax is applied to the distribution, not the profit
  • VAT at 6% plus about 12% surcharges on the VAT
  • No transfer-pricing adjustment, no late tax, no penalties
  • Treaty relief is available and documented, not assumed

Every route has a different file. The number is the easy part; the documents are the work.

What a tool cannot decide

The number is the start of the argument, not the end of it.

This tool answers one question. The framework is where that answer is tested against the other four.
